items.title: AI Adoption Is a Myth

items.title: LLM Model-Swapping Trick Can Expose AI Reasoning Traces
items.raw_excerpt: A new research reveals that a model-swapping trick can trick LLMs into exposing their internal reasoning traces, potentially bypassing safety measures and leaking sensitive information. Experts recommend strengthening protections on model reasoning processes.

title_i18n.en: LLM Model-Swapping Trick Can Expose AI Reasoning Traces
title_i18n.zh: LLM模型切换技巧可暴露AI推理痕迹
title_i18n.es: El truco de intercambiar modelos LLM puede exponer las trazas de razonamiento de la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: A new research reveals that a model-swapping trick can trick LLMs into exposing their internal reasoning traces, potentially bypassing safety measures and leaking sensitive information. Experts recommend strengthening protections on model reasoning processes.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一项新研究揭示，通过模型交换（model-swapping）技巧，攻击者可以诱导大语言模型（LLM）暴露其内部的推理痕迹。这种方法可能绕过模型的安全防护，导致敏感信息泄露。相关专家建议加强对模型推理过程的保护，以防此类攻击。

items.title: How ONESTRUCTION built the Ishigaki-IDS foundation model with AWS GenAIIC
items.raw_excerpt: ONESTRUCTION, with technical advisory from the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center, built Ishigaki-IDS, a foundation model specialized for construction and BIM workflows. This architectural case study shows how they combined synthetic data, a three-stage training pipeline, and verifiable rewards on Amazon EC2 to build a domain model in a data-scarce field.

items.title: How Pixieset achieved 35% AI feature adoption by solving the right problem with Amazon Bedrock
items.raw_excerpt: Photographers are among the most skeptical audiences for generative AI. Learn how Pixieset used Amazon Bedrock to launch an AI-generated alt text feature to millions of users in four months, reaching 35% adoption by automating the tedious image SEO work photographers avoid, without touching the creative craft they take pride in.

title_i18n.en: How Pixieset achieved 35% AI feature adoption by solving the right problem with Amazon Bedrock
title_i18n.zh: Pixieset如何通过Amazon Bedrock解决正确问题，实现35%的AI功能采用率
title_i18n.es: Cómo Pixieset logró un 35% de adopción de funciones de IA al resolver el problema correcto con Amazon Bedrock

excerpt_i18n.en: Photographers are among the most skeptical audiences for generative AI. excerpt_i18n.zh: 摄影师是对生成式AI最持怀疑态度的群体之一。了解Pixieset如何利用Amazon Bedrock在四个月内向数百万用户推出AI生成的替代文本功能，并通过自动方式达到35%的采用率。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los fotógrafos se encuentran entre las audiencias más escépticas respecto a la IA generativa. items.title: First Orion accelerates QA automation using Amazon Nova Act
